purpose: Define deterministic conflict detection across all active/candidate listener bindings before activation, including address/port/transport collisions and reserved-binding rules.

topics.name: Listener Binding Conflict Validation
topics.purpose: Define deterministic conflict detection across all active/candidate listener bindings before activation, including address/port/transport collisions and reserved-binding rules.

semantics.candidate_rule: Conflicts are checked against running, enabled and candidate bindings according to the owning activation policy.
semantics.wildcard_rule: Wildcard/any-interface binding conflicts are evaluated against specific-interface bindings according to platform semantics.
semantics.reserved_rule: Reserved/default bindings are protected by explicit ownership/configuration rules.
semantics.failure_rule: Conflicting candidate hard-fails before affected activation.
semantics.no_repair_rule: Validator never silently increments/substitutes ports to make a config work.
semantics.report_rule: Conflict report identifies both listener identities and exact binding tuples.

invariants.rule: Listener/service identity is stable and separate from mutable listen binding, protocol configuration and runtime process/session state.

prose.summary: Define deterministic conflict detection across all active/candidate listener bindings before activation, including address/port/transport collisions and reserved-binding rules.
